video_title: Jamison Battle teaches us how to shoot and his “flow state” playoff heroics

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's impact on the Raptors' team culture and championship success
quotes.excerpt: he's the GOAT, right? And to be able to see what he's done and the impact
quotes.quote: He's the GOAT, right? And to be able to see what he's done and the impact that he has on this city, not only Toronto, but Canada as a whole, to be here and win a championship is something that you don't take lightly. And the culture that they had as a team is something that we're trying to emulate, and what he did and what he did for the Raptors is something that is super special.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's competitive nature will raise the Raptors' floor and ceiling
quotes.excerpt: the type of guy he is and the competitor that he is is only going to help us
quotes.quote: The type of guy he is and the competitor that he is is only going to help us. It's going to raise our floor, but also it's going to raise our ceiling to the max just because of how he plays and how he fits into our system and how he fits into our team and our chemistry. And just how he wants to win, and everyone in this organization wants to win and wants to do it the right way.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors' playoff experience against the 76ers builds hunger for future success
quotes.excerpt: now we're hungry for it, right? And you add a guy like Kawhi to that
quotes.quote: Now we're hungry for it, right? And you add a guy like Kawhi to that. For me, I was just waiting for an opportunity and I knew you just got to, I mean, I think it's been a mantra for my whole career, just make the most of your opportunities because you don't know when they're coming. They're going to come fast and they're going to come whenever, but it's just being ready for when that opportunity presents itself to go out there and do what you can do.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Getting into a 'flow state' during high-stakes playoff games
quotes.excerpt: you get in the flow state, definitely, but it's just having that confidence
quotes.quote: You get in the flow state, definitely, but it's just having that confidence. And then I think just within the whole of the team, it's like whenever I take a shot, you know that everyone feels like it's going in and just that gives me confidence because everyone else believes in me. But it's just falling back on that work and just waiting for that opportunity.

quotes.speaker: Jamison Battle
quotes.summary_phrase: Young players must step up and seize opportunities during the season
quotes.excerpt: there's times where we're going to be relied upon and there's times where our opportunities are going to come
quotes.quote: There's times where we're going to be relied upon and there's times where our opportunities are going to come and what are we going to make of it, right? But it's something that as competitors and as basketball players that you don't put too much on the forefront of your mind just because you don't want to over-analyze and over-exaggerate what's actually really happening. So I think there's going to be times for sure, like you talk about, but then there's also times where you just let the game come to you and let the game let the game play.
